entities.name: Vincenz Müller
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vincenz Müller was a German military officer and general who served in the Imperial German Army, the Wehrmacht and the National People's Army. Post-war, Müller became a politician and member of the East German parliament, the Volkskammer.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vincenz Müller was a German military officer and general who served in the Imperial German Army, the Wehrmacht and the National People's Army. Post-war, Müller became a politician and member of the East German parliament, the Volkskammer.
